definitions: To overcome obstacles or difficulties to progress
To navigate through a challenging situation or physical barrier
examples: She had to make her way through a dense crowd.
They made their way through the legal complexities.
We will make our way through the forest.
lemma: to make your way through something that is stopping you
pastTenses: made your way through something that was stopping you, made your way through something that was stopping you
